sloka: घातयिष्यति दण्डेन तीक्ष्णेन कृत निश्चयः ।किम् मे सुहृद्भिः व्यसनम् पश्यद्भिः जीवितांतरे ।इह एव प्रायम् आसिष्ये पुण्ये सागर रोधसि ॥४-५३-१९॥
transliteration: ghātayiṣyati daṇḍena tīkṣṇena kṛta niścayaḥ ।kim me suhṛdbhiḥ vyasanam paśyadbhiḥ jīvitāṁtare ।iha eva prāyam āsiṣye puṇye sāgara rodhasi ॥4-53-19॥

translations.english: Coming to a conclusion after due deliberation Angada, heir apparent, profoundly wise, endowed with sturdy and broad shoulders like those of a lion or a bull, spoke in a sweet voice to the elderly, respectable monkeys, dwellers of the forest:
